title: Find and book a family outing on a day off
summary: A parent asked Muse to check availability and prices for a family of 5; it found a 2 PM slot, noted weekday savings and booked after approval.
agent_role: The agent researched availability and pricing, found an opening and noted savings, then booked tickets once the parent approved.
outcome: Author reports the agent found a 2 PM opening with weekday pricing savings and booked the tickets after approval.
what_they_did: A parent's kids had Friday off. They asked the Muse agent to check availability and prices at a local attraction for a family of five. The agent booked only after the parent approved.
how_it_went: The author says it found a 2 PM opening, pointed out weekday savings, and booked the tickets once approved.
worth_knowing: The booking happened only after the parent gave approval, which keeps spending in human hands.
